title: Average Salary: Departments VS Company
goal: Compare each department monthly average salary with the company average for that same month.
strategy: Join payments to departments and aggregate sums and counts by month. Compare department sum times company count with company sum times department count, so unequal group sizes and rounding cannot distort the comparison.
